work_unit.title: 分离候选发起身份和人类治理权限
work_unit.goal: 让认证 Agent 或 Service 发起 Submission 与 ActionRequest，同时把 Review、Action Approval 和 Acceptance 保持为认证真人的独立权限与不可伪造命令。

codebase_context.current_gap: Go adjudication_store and connector_store persist a hard-coded user principal for candidate creation. The TypeScript facade already has authenticated actor context but does not transport a typed principal to the Go command boundary.
codebase_context.authority_rule: Candidate authorship may be Agent or Service. Review, Action Approval, and Acceptance remain human commands. One human may hold all three human authorities when the candidate/request principal is distinct.
codebase_context.security_boundary: Principal identity is derived from the authenticated HTTP/facade context. Request bodies may not select or override principal type or id.

execution_constraints.ownership: Do not alter unrelated Paperclip authorization behavior. Keep compatibility for authenticated board users and existing read contracts.

amendments.reason: TDD preparation found the shared lifecycle receipt and audit transaction hard-coded principal_type=user. T003 cannot truthfully persist Agent/Service candidate identity without changing this existing command boundary.
amendments.constraint: Parameterize receipt, audit, idempotency, and scope handling only; unrelated lifecycle handlers remain human-only through their existing validators.

amendments.reason: GREEN introduced a narrow candidate validator with the same workspace, resource, idempotency, and request-hash mechanics as the human lifecycle validator. The packet's required refactor phase calls for converging that duplication without widening command authority.
amendments.constraint: Extract only shared structural validation; principal allowlists and error codes remain command-specific.

tdd_plan.red: Add Go and facade/route tests proving Agent or Service candidate creation, body principal spoof rejection, human review/approval/acceptance, and existing self-governance rejection.
tdd_plan.green: Introduce the minimum typed command principal derived at the authenticated boundary and persist it on Submission or ActionRequest.
tdd_plan.refactor: After green, converge duplicated principal validation without broadening which commands non-human principals may execute.

commands: pnpm --filter @paperclipai/server exec vitest run src/services/verrail-domain-api-client.test.ts src/__tests__/adjudication-routes.test.ts src/__tests__/connector-routes.test.ts
validation_loop.failure_handling: Keep authorization failures fail-closed. Fix the narrowest boundary that fails; do not accept a client-supplied principal field as authentication evidence.

checks: Agent and Service can author candidates but cannot issue human governance decisions
The authenticated boundary, not request JSON, selects principal identity
One human can govern a candidate authored by a distinct Agent or Service
Existing user self-review, self-approval, and owner acceptance constraints remain enforced
Stored audit and domain facts carry the actual authenticated principal

stop_conditions: Authentication context cannot distinguish human, agent, and trusted internal service without a new product decision.
A proposed implementation would let the request body impersonate a principal.
A proposed change would allow Agent or Service principals to issue Review, Action Approval, or Acceptance.
Required schema changes exceed the existing principal columns and would overlap T004 migration scope.
